items.prompt: A crawler discovers 5 000 URLs/s but the fetchers manage 800/s. After an hour the in-memory frontier holds 15 million URLs and the process is killed for running out of memory.
items.why: Sustained overload with an unbounded buffer. Bound the stages and slow discovery down (or spill to disk). Adding a bigger queue only delays the crash.

items.prompt: A public API must allow each API key at most 1 000 requests per hour, no matter how idle the servers are.
items.why: A fixed per-client quota that ignores current load is rate limiting. Backpressure reacts to the system's actual capacity.

items.prompt: A sneaker drop brings 2 million users in the first minute; checkout can process 3 000 per minute. The business wants fair, first-come access and a checkout that stays up.
items.why: Demand far above core capacity for a known spike → admission control: a waiting room at the edge releasing users at the sustainable rate, with position and ETA.

items.prompt: The recommendation service is timing out on every call. Callers keep waiting 2 s for each request and their own thread pools are exhausted.
items.why: The dependency is failing, not merely busy. Trip a breaker, fail fast, and serve a fallback until it recovers.

items.prompt: Under peak load the order API's latency grows from 80 ms to 40 s before clients time out; the servers keep processing requests whose callers have already left.
items.why: A growing queue with work nobody waits for. Bound in-flight requests, shed fast with 503 + Retry-After, and drop work past its deadline.

items.prompt: A payment webhook handler fails on about 1 in 10 000 messages because of malformed payloads; those messages are retried forever and block the queue.
items.why: Individual poison messages, not overload. Cap the attempts and move them to a dead-letter queue.

items.prompt: A nightly job imports 50 million rows into the main database and saturates it, so user queries slow to a crawl until the import finishes.
items.why: The producer outruns a shared consumer. Pace the importer (bounded concurrency, adaptive to DB latency) so it yields to user traffic.
